metadata.description: Plugins from Chameleon Labs — skills, agents, and tooling for Claude Code.

plugins.name: agent-spawner
plugins.description: Scaffold, package, and deploy Claude agents — channel adapters (Telegram/Slack/Discord), HMAC-signed bridges between local + managed, IDE configs, systemd/Task Scheduler units, and SCP/SSH deploy to a Linux host.

plugins.name: license-validator
plugins.description: Shared license verification for Chameleon Labs commercial plugins. Install once; all Chameleon Labs paid plugins use it to verify licenses and cache a 24-hour offline token.

plugins.name: scan-source
plugins.description: Layered local security scan for downloaded/cloned source — malware/supply-chain (GuardDog), known CVEs + leaked secrets (Trivy, OSV-Scanner, pip-audit), and insecure-code SAST (Semgrep). Interprets results and recommends concrete fixes.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Strips AI fingerprints from writing and rewrites it in your own voice. A catalog of 200+ AI tells to avoid plus a personal voice profile, applied to clean up AI-sounding text or to draft fresh prose that doesn't read like a chatbot wrote it. Includes a guided setup that builds your voice profile from your own writing.

plugins.name: repo-hygiene
plugins.description: Keep any repo's agent-facing layer healthy — version-manager (standardized version bumps + changelogs, auto-detects where the version lives), repo-doctor (audit of AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md topology, CodeMap freshness, token cost, doc drift), claude-md-optimizer (rightsize CLAUDE.md per Anthropic context-engineering guidance), and unify-agents-md (make AGENTS.md the single canonical guide every coding CLI follows).

plugins.name: docs-toolkit
plugins.description: Generate and maintain project documentation — project-documenter (user-facing feature docs + sitemap), technical-documenter (developer/API docs), feature-documenter (feature inventory), update-code-map (navigable CodeMap.md with verified line numbers; spec bundled), and raginclude-generator (.raginclude files for RAG indexing).

plugins.name: yt-transcript
plugins.description: Download YouTube transcripts from any URL form (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed) or bare video ID into a local project's Notes directory, with full venv lifecycle handled by a bundled runner.

plugins.name: model-registry
plugins.description: Wire any project to a daily-refreshed public registry of current LLM model IDs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) so code stops hardcoding model names that go stale. Installs the zero-dependency Python/TypeScript client, migrates hardcoded IDs, and manages bundled fallbacks.
